review_mode: independent content review with separate numeric-consistency audit and post-repair verification

findings.evidence: The pre-repair PDF contained a full English abstract with valuation and rating logic in an otherwise Chinese report.
findings.fix_required: Remove the English abstract and retain only a short English disclaimer where required.

findings.evidence: CNY58.44325bn based on disclosed-dilution shares had been labeled as quoted market capitalization, while quoted legal-share market capitalization was CNY57.55273bn.
findings.fix_required: Separate quoted legal-share market capitalization from the disclosed-dilution capitalization sensitivity and add the quoted value to the final valuation table.

findings.evidence: The pre-repair three-quarter threshold did not distinguish Q3, nine-month cumulative profit and the Q4 residual.
findings.fix_required: Create a Q2 implied range and explicit bear/base/bull Q3E-Q4E bridge that sums exactly to each H2 scenario.

findings.evidence: The pre-repair report discussed employee-plan participation and 231.026272m remaining treasury shares only qualitatively.
findings.fix_required: Add 0/50/100 percent employee-plan and remaining-treasury-share cash-share-expense-per-share sensitivities.

findings.evidence: Several passages used direct position language rather than research-priority and monitoring language.
findings.fix_required: Translate all house actions into research upgrade, maintain observation, lower priority or reassessment language.

findings.evidence: The pre-repair forecast table mixed 2025 reported accounting EPS with forecast valuation-dilution EPS in one row.
Polyester gross profit was shown as CNY2.431bn rather than the CNY2.434bn revenue-minus-cost result.
findings.fix_required: Use the audited revenue-minus-cost presentation consistently.
